verdict.rationale: Bugbot documents on-demand reviews: commenting `cursor review` or `bugbot run` on any PR triggers one. Automatic reviews run only 'when enabled', and a community user confirms turning automatic reviews off and triggering them on request. Nothing in the pack covers skipping draft PRs or filtering by branch or label, which are core parts of the story. missing for 10: skip-draft control, branch-based filtering, label-based filtering, independent corroboration of granular trigger controls.
